description: This Java class represents an HTML widget component within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles rendering HTML templates, including support for FreeMarker templates, decorator sections, subwidgets, and multi-block content, with functionalities for debugging, HTML validation, and script management.

classes.name: HtmlWidget
classes.description: Represents an HTML widget with support for templates, decorators, and subwidgets, facilitating rendering within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: HtmlTemplate
classes.description: Handles rendering of HTML templates, including inline FTL content and external template files, with support for multi-block processing.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecorator
classes.description: Represents a decorator for HTML templates, allowing sections to be defined and rendered separately.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecoratorSection
classes.description: Represents individual sections within a decorator, containing subwidgets to be rendered.

classes.name: ExtendedWrapper
classes.description: Custom FreeMarker BeansWrapper to handle special wrapping of Strings and Collections for HTML encoding.

classes.name: StringHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper class for Strings to encode them for HTML output during FreeMarker rendering.

classes.name: CollectionHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper class for Collections to encode their string representations for HTML during FreeMarker rendering.

methods.name: renderHtmlTemplate
methods.description: Renders an HTML or FTL template based on the supplied location, supporting boundary comments and error handling.

methods.name: writeError
methods.description: Outputs an error message to the writer.
